cases.name: Elaysha "Lay" Davis' Gilliam
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Elaysha, a beloved mother, daughter, sister, aunt and niece danced into heaven on January 20, 2024, in Kansas City, Missouri.

Elaysha accepted God as her Lord and Savior, at an early age. She attended Impact Family Worship Center along with other churches, as much as she could. She was loved by so many and was always willing to help anyone. She was known for feeding the homeless. Elaysha had a heart of gold.

Elaysha was a big part of Operation Breakthrough, as this is where her children attended. She attended Kansas City Public schools and obtained her G.E.D. Elaysha worked at Johnson Controls. She will always be known for having a heart of gold and being a daddy's girl.

Elaysha was known for being the life of the party and breaking out in a twerk session. She was very energetic."
cases.narrative: On 2/19/2024, her body was reportedly found in a field near Dunbar Park in Kansas City, MO.
